verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26270376 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318630 dated 2026-02-27. It has one item: 10,000 pcs of CMP-GAM-002 (Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5) at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2026-04-02. Terms are EXW Boise and NET30. The delivery terms text is internally inconsistent.
red_flags: Delivery terms conflict: the document states EXW Boise and says DDP is not agreed. It also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer would normally arrange and pay for these. The charges are not quantified, so the invoiced total could exceed qty x unit price.
The quantity has no unit of measure, and the document shows no total value.
The document has no issue date. The only dates are the PO date (2026-02-27) and the confirmed delivery date (2026-04-02).
observations: The document is a clean, typed single page with no handwriting, stamps, signatures or corrections.
The unit of measure for the quantity is not stated.
The description wraps across three lines in the table: 'Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5'.
